title: Apartment 10, Block A, Hanover Quay, Dublin 2
seoTitle: Apartment 10, Block A, Hanover Quay, Dublin 2
description:
A SUPERB SIXTH-FLOOR TWO-BEDROOM APARTMENT WITH STUNNING WATER VIEWS

A rare opportunity to rent a beautifully presented and exceptionally spacious two-bedroom, sixth-floor apartment enjoying spectacular panoramic views over Grand Canal Dock towards the Dublin Mountains.

This impressive property combines generous proportions, an abundance of natural light and an enviable waterfront location, making it an ideal choice for those seeking stylish city living in the heart of Dublin 2.

The south-facing living room is a particular highlight, with floor-to-ceiling, wall-to-wall windows maximising the wonderful outlook across the water and allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the room throughout the day. The living area opens directly onto a private balcony, creating the perfect spot to enjoy the views, morning coffee or an evening drink while watching life around the Dock.

The living room also provides ample space for both comfortable seating and dining, making it equally suited to relaxing or entertaining. A fully fitted kitchen is located just off the living area and comes complete with all modern appliances and ample storage.

The entrance hall benefits from a large dedicated storage area, while there is also a separate utility area, providing excellent practical storage and functionality rarely found in city-centre apartments.

Both bedrooms are generously proportioned. The master bedroom enjoys excellent wardrobe space and benefits from a stylish en-suite bathroom, as well as space for a desk. The second bedroom is also a substantial double bedroom with good storage

A further spacious main bathroom features a bath and power shower.

The apartment is finished throughout to a high standard, with quality wood flooring to the living room and entrance hall and luxurious carpeting to the bedrooms. Additional features include gas-fired central heating, secure underground parking for one car and excellent storage provision.

Location & Lifestyle

The apartment enjoys an exceptional position in Grand Canal Dock, Dublin 2, one of Dublin's most sought-after waterfront neighbourhoods. The area offers the perfect balance of peaceful waterside surroundings and vibrant city-centre living, with an impressive selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, gyms and everyday amenities all within easy reach.

Residents can enjoy a fantastic choice of local cafés and restaurants, including waterside dining, coffee shops and popular neighbourhood favourites, while Fresh supermarket and SPAR provide convenient options for everyday shopping. There are also several gyms and fitness studios in the immediate area.

For entertainment and culture, the iconic Bord Gáis Energy Theatre is right in the heart of Grand Canal Dock, offering an extensive programme of theatre, musicals, concerts and performances. The Aviva Stadium is also within easy walking distance, while Dublin's city-centre attractions, Trinity College, Grafton Street and St Stephen's Green are all readily accessible.

Grand Canal Dock forms part of Dublin's thriving Docklands business district and being home to numerous major international companies.

Transport links are excellent, with Grand Canal Dock DART station, Pearse Station, Dublin Bus routes and the Luas Red Line all within convenient walking distance. The area is also exceptionally well suited to cycling and walking, with the city centre easily accessible on foot.

This is a truly special apartment offering spacious, light-filled accommodation, secure parking and outstanding waterfront views in one of Dublin's most desirable locations.

Available to view and let immediately. Early viewing is highly recommended.
